core_message: Sully Sullenberger saved all 155 passengers by ditching his plane into the Hudson River in under four minutes.
title: 155 Lives Saved in 4 Minutes: The Hudson Miracle
description:
In January 2009, a flock of birds sent an Airbus A320 out of the sky. The pilots had less than four minutes to decide where to land, and they chose the river.

This is the story of the Miracle on the Hudson, where every single person on board survived a high-speed water landing.

Key points:
- Bird strike caused dual engine failure
- 155 passengers and crew survived
- Entire event took less than 4 minutes

Based on the Wikipedia article "US Airways Flight 1549" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/US_Airways_Flight_1549), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
